notes.title: CODE: PANDORA 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Friends, fans — and yes, even haters.

While we're still preparing the remake of Witch 1, I’m excited to present the next chapter: CODE: Pandora.
Originally, the Absolute Weapon was supposed to be just a DLC for the first game — a small side adventure on a unique planet. But, as fate would have it, DLC development dragged on, and content kept piling up. So, with the iron will of the Dark Lord — and a random push of the launch button by our resident Goblin — it was decided: this story deserved a full sequel.

What’s different this time?
The biggest change: we’re no longer limited to a single planet. Now, your adventures will take you across nine worlds, with your headquarters stationed on the intergalactic base Ghost-5. From there, you’ll be contacting the lords of the Pandora galaxy, and your ultimate goal will be to piece together the full coordinates of the shadow planet where the Absolute Weapon is hidden.

There’s more — for the first time, Driply won’t be the only playable character. You’ll be joined by Lika, who, unlike diplomatic Driply, specializes in sabotage. But the choice is yours: plot daring sabotage missions, or befriend everyone in sight — it’s all up to you.

In the end, whether you get the coordinates by force, by cunning, or by friendship, the adventure will be yours to shape.

Thank you all for supporting the games and the Pandora universe — just as you did with Witch.

With love and respect,
Elbaf45

notes.title: Candle Daemon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
So the game is about the adventures of Jack, before he entered the hellish universe of the Jester.

Chelsea's aunt Agnete has been caught between realms. Her mysterious disappearance from the human world has set off a whirlwind journey that will ultimately culminate in Chelsea vanishing as well. The World between Worlds , a space that some mistakenly confuse with Limbo or Purgatory, is actually covered in cracks, where beings fall in from different planes of existence. You can arrive here from anywhere: from the Moon Realm, Hell, Heaven, and the human world.

notes.title: News & Updates
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
Thank you very much for your interest in the game! Some ideas you shared with me are all very entertaining, thank you!
So what's new
1) Big Picture mode full support with the ability to play via Steam Link (Remote Play on TV)
2) Added Steam Trading Cards
3) Added some items store points (animated backgrounds and avatars)
What lies ahead?
DLC for Witch 2 (Lost Paintings) is still a working title.
The next standalone game will feature Chelsea's sister Melissa. The game will be in the framework of the Chronicles of the Witch.
Witch 3 will also be. But later.
